title: PCL:PEG Electrospinning
author: Kenneth Schackart
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yaffsbn
materials: Place the solvent solutions on a rocker overnight to fully dissolve.
Combine the polymer solutions at a rate of 3 parts PCL solution to 1 part PEG solution.

steps.title: Prepare solvent solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a solvent solution consisting of 70% chloroform and 30% acetone in a 50 mL tube (e.g., 14 mL chloroform and 6 mL acetone). Perform this step in a chemical fume hood.

steps.title: Prepare PCL solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g PCL in 10 mL of the prepared solvent solution in a 15 mL tube to create a 10 Mass/% volume solution.

steps.title: Prepare PEG solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 500 mg PEG in 10 mL of the prepared solvent solution in a second 15 mL tube to create a 5 Mass/% volume solution.

steps.title: Prepare collector plate
steps.instruction: Set up the collection surface using aluminum foil and cover slips.

substeps.instruction: Fold a 10 cm × 10 cm piece of aluminum foil.
Attach the foil square to a copper plate.
Attach cover slips onto the aluminum foil using double-sided tape.

steps.title: Position collector and pump
steps.instruction: Position the copper plate normal to the syringe pump within the enclosure, approximately 9 cm away from the needle.

substeps.instruction: Note: Increasing the distance will decrease fiber diameter.

steps.title: Prepare syringe for spinning
steps.instruction: Prepare the PCL:PEG solution and load it into the syringe.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the PCL:PEG solution for 3 minutes.
Pour the solution onto a petri dish and draw it into a 10 mL syringe with a 23 ga. tip.
Purge bubbles by holding the syringe tip upward and depressing the plunger.
Load and secure the syringe onto the syringe pump.

steps.title: Establish electrical connections
steps.instruction: Connect the power source leads to the setup.

substeps.instruction: Clip the ground (black) wire to the leads coming from the copper plate.
Clip the positive (red) wire to the syringe needle.

steps.title: Initiate electrospinning
steps.instruction: Start the pump and apply high voltage to begin spinning.

substeps.instruction: Set the syringe pump rate to 20 µL/min and begin pumping.
Turn on the power source and set it to 15,000 V.
Do not touch power source leads; turn off power to make adjustments.

steps.title: Optimize and maintain spinning
steps.instruction: Adjust the setup during the process to ensure quality.

substeps.instruction: Aim the needle/syringe pump if necessary to obtain a uniform layer on all cover slips.
If clumping occurs at the needle, clear it using a non-conducting material.

steps.title: Collect fibers
steps.instruction: Stop the process and harvest the fibers from the cover slips.

substeps.instruction: Once desired thickness is reached, turn off the power supply and allow to cool for 2-3 min.
Use a blade to cut the fibers between the cover slips, taking care not to disturb fibers on the slips.
